16:22.race_name: Tipping Tom On SBK Bet Feed Handicap (Div I)

runners.comment: Regular at Newcastle; successful in two of his last three runs; cards dropped right latest
runners.name: Dark Kestrel
runners.spotlight: Regular at Newcastle; found the cards dropping right to make it two wins from his last three starts (5f); chance of defying top weight and adding to his tally depends on whether this race pans out as favourably.

runners.comment: 0-13 since debut win but could go well with Newcastle reappearance under his belt
runners.name: Binadham
runners.spotlight: Record of 0-13 since debut win but he could go well off current mark with Newcastle reappearance under his belt; ended his 2025 campaign with a good second at that venue (5f).

runners.comment: All wins at Lingfield; ran well in sole Wolverhampton attempt; consistent; in the mix
runners.name: Toolatetonegotiate
runners.spotlight: Has gained all wins at Lingfield, the most recent in January; creditable third there in both outings since; ran well in sole Wolverhampton attempt; consistent filly who is again likely to be thereabouts.

runners.comment: Raced mostly at 6f but went close in last attempt over 5f; broadly consistent; player
runners.name: Charlie Mason
runners.spotlight: Broadly consistent; beaten favourite in last two runs but did well to make the frame at Kempton latest, having endured a wide trip; raced mostly at 6f but went close in last attempt over 5f; interesting with Rossa Ryan back on board, with his strong record under this rider featuring two wins.

runners.comment: Opened her AW account in Southwell event last time; still fairly unexposed in this sphere
runners.name: Brazilian Belle
runners.spotlight: In-form filly who opened her AW account in Southwell event (5f) last time and remains much less exposed in this sphere than on turf; may build on that success; respected back up just 2lb.

runners.comment: Largely consistent form on turf for current yard features three wins
runners.name: Over Spiced
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent form on turf for current yard features three wins (5f); ran well at Bath when last seen five months ago; possibilities, provided she's as effective returned to AW.

runners.comment: Well drawn for one who gained his 2025 turf wins making all; suited by Wolverhampton
runners.name: Jojo Rabbit
runners.owner: Grange Park Racing XIII & Ruth Carr
runners.spotlight: Failed to enhance his respectable strike-rate over C&D when last seen but has a fighting chance off current mark provided he returns in better form; well drawn for one who gained his 2025 turf wins making all.

runners.comment: 0-11 in handicaps and ran poorly for new yard the last two times
runners.name: Megaphone
runners.spotlight: Gained maiden/novice wins early last year but is 0-11 in handicaps and ran poorly for new yard the last two times (bled from nose latest); new headgear combination needs to help.

runners.comment: Three wins in Class 6 at Wolverhampton last term; this is a better grade
runners.name: Candy Warhol
runners.owner: Homecroft Wealth Paul J Dixon & Partners
runners.spotlight: Showed plenty of form, notably three wins in Class 6, at Wolverhampton last term; however, the negatives are his lack of recent match practice and lack of a success in this higher grade.

runners.comment: Turn looks near; back up in grade but receives weight all round; not dismissed
runners.name: Buraback
runners.spotlight: Finished a solid second at Chelmsford (5f Class 6) on his last two starts and his turn looks near; back up in grade but receives weight all round and remains favourably treated on plenty of form; not dismissed.

16:55.race_name: Tipping Tom On SBK Bet Feed Handicap (Div II)

runners.comment: Good record in 6f handicaps at Wolverhampton; should be as effective back over 5f
runners.name: Addarella
runners.spotlight: Belied her 66-1 odds last time (stable debut) to take her form figures in 6f handicaps at Wolverhampton, all since November, to 1312; gives the impression she'll be as effective back over 5f; in the mix.

runners.comment: Recorded a clearcut win from the front over C&D on penultimate start; not ruled out
runners.name: Beaumadier
runners.spotlight: On a career-high mark but is difficult to dismiss, having recorded a clearcut win from the front over C&D on penultimate start; awkwardly away and unable to dominate at Lingfield latest.

runners.comment: Front-runner; form dipped last time but generally productive otherwise for current yard
runners.name: Sams Xpress
runners.spotlight: Productive front-runner whose largely consistent record for current yard features four wins, including twice over C&D, and four placed efforts; out of the money last time but may rebound.

runners.comment: Poorly handicapped, being 11lb higher than last AW appearance
runners.name: Moes Legacy
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly on turf last year, winning four times; effective on AW in the past but looks poorly handicapped, being 11lb higher than last appearance in this sphere.

runners.comment: Broadly consistent record on AW features two C&D wins; this race may pan out her way
runners.name: Hint Of Humour
runners.spotlight: Broadly consistent record on AW features two wins over C&D; fared best of the rest behind clearcut winner Beaumadier, who was able to dominate, last time; this race may pan out her way; solid chance.

runners.comment: Inconsistent since the last of his nine turf wins; others preferred
runners.name: Albegone
runners.owner: D B & Mrs C Lamplough & Partner
runners.spotlight: Posted best AW effort when second at Newcastle (5f) on penultimate outing; inconsistent otherwise since the last of his nine turf wins; not sure what to expect from him.

runners.comment: Did well to finish third at Wolverhampton last August; that form gives her a shout
runners.name: Glory Hyde
runners.spotlight: Triple turf scorer who is 0-5 on AW; however, did well to finish third at Wolverhampton last August, having raced wide, and that form gives her a good shout; market may offer further guidance (off since October).

runners.comment: In-form 8yo who is an eight-time course winner; back up in class but not ruled out
runners.name: Gustav Graves
runners.spotlight: In-form 8yo, placed at Wolverhampton and Newcastle on his last two starts; goes back up in class but it's difficult to rule out this eight-time course winner who should get a good pace to aim at.

runners.comment: Hit a great spell of form last spring, winning three times over C&D; attractively treated
runners.name: Phoenix Beach
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent of late but his most recent effort can be forgiven (saddle slipped); hit a great spell of form last spring, winning three times over C&D, and this may be the time to catch him; attractively treated.

17:30.race_name: SBK: Betting Without The Bull Handicap

runners.breeder: Exors Of The Late Mrs L Peacock
runners.comment: Collared close home over 1m6f here last time; back up 2lb and no win since August 2024
runners.name: One Cool Dreamer
runners.spotlight: Collared close home over 1m6f here last time; just as effective at 1m4f last year but nudged back up 2lb and no win since August 2024.

runners.comment: Third at Lingfield (1m4f) last time was his closest finish since last January's win
runners.name: Pleasant Man
runners.spotlight: Keeps edging down the weights and third of seven at Lingfield (1m4f) last time was his closest finish since last January's win; probably thereabouts.

runners.comment: Off since leaving Harry Derham for 15,000gns in December; makes his Flat handicap debut
runners.name: Turn And Finish
runners.spotlight: 1-12 over hurdles and sparked only once (two runs back) in recent starts, before leaving Harry Derham for 15,000gns in December; after just three Flat runs, he now makes his handicap debut in this sphere; others preferred.

runners.breeder: Al Rabban Racing/Lope De Vega Syndicate
runners.comment: Best 2025 Flat form was on turf, whereas he faces a stiff task judged on his AW record
runners.name: Made All
runners.spotlight: Well beaten, at best, over hurdles on last three starts; competitive judged on best 2025 Flat form but that was on turf, whereas he faces a stiff task judged on his AW record (0-10 off significantly lower marks).

runners.comment: Showed ability on all three starts; unexposed handicap debutant who needs a close look
runners.name: John Galt
runners.spotlight: Made debut in only December and showed ability on all three starts, best when never dangerous at Kempton (1m3f) on second outing; made most there (1m4f) on latest; unexposed handicap debutant who needs a close look.

runners.comment: 2nd in two of three Irish handicaps; off 210 days but this AW newcomer needs a second look
runners.name: Atheneum
runners.spotlight: Second at Killarney (1m6f) last summer in two of three Irish handicaps for John Joseph Murphy, trying cheekpieces when short-headed on latest outing (good); off 210 days but this lightly raced AW newcomer needs a second look.

runners.breeder: Ashtown B/S O B Sarl E Puerari G Bozo
runners.comment: Back to Flat last two starts, winning under Millie Wonnacott at Southwell (1m3f) on latest
runners.name: Chicago Storm
runners.spotlight: Back to Flat last two starts when a fair fourth here (1m6f) and winning under Millie Wonnacott at Southwell (1m3f); back up 4lb but needs respect.

runners.comment: Had some exposure to 1m4f in his 2024 and 2025 Irish days, but best efforts over shorter
runners.name: Latin
runners.spotlight: Four wins this winter over 1m-9.4f, the last three of which were at this track; fair never-dangerous fourth when he tried 1m2f at Lingfield on latest start and he did have some exposure to 1m4f in his 2024 and 2025 Irish days, but best efforts over shorter.

runners.comment: Three AW wins last year, the latest over C&D in October and he's now back to that mark
runners.name: Meet Me In Meraki
runners.owner: Spiers & Hartwell Ltd & Mrs E Evans
runners.spotlight: Three AW wins last year, the latest over C&D in October and he's now back to that mark for the first time since; bits of encouragement since give him a place in calculations.

runners.comment: Back up 3lb after Lingfield win five weeks ago but probably ready for another bold show
runners.name: Sea Of Charm
runners.spotlight: Three turf wins over about 1m4f last May-August and she scored again at this trip, leading over 1f out and hanging on by a short head, at Lingfield five weeks ago after nearly six months off; back up 3lb but effective at this track too and probably ready for another bold show.

runners.comment: Career-low mark; first two of his three wins last year came at this track in March
runners.name: Green Team
runners.spotlight: Underperforming on AW this winter but this is a career-low mark and the first two of his three wins last year were registered at this track in March; beaten only just over 3l on latest outing and no way is he ruled out.

18:00.race_name: Friday Night Live With SBK Handicap (Div I)

runners.comment: Four 1m wins at Southwell this winter; still feasibly weighted but now upped in class
runners.name: Marry The Night
runners.spotlight: Thriving on AW this winter, successful for the fourth time when a snug winner at Southwell last week; his two latest defeats have come when upped to Class 5, however, and this track presents a different test; feasible mark (just 2lb higher than last week) if the tighter track holds no terrors.

runners.comment: Beat 2 next-time-out winners over C&D last month; 2lb rise fair; tricky draw but respected
runners.name: American State
runners.spotlight: Had subsequent winners in second and third when landing a C&D handicap last month, his first run after wind surgery; a 2lb rise wouldn't look beyond him on that evidence and he rates a key player despite a wide stall.

runners.comment: Three wins, including C&D, in the first half of 2025; fair mark if ready to roll on return
runners.name: Mariner
runners.spotlight: In good form in the first half of 2025, winning over C&D last February before adding turf successes at Doncaster (1m) and Ripon (1m2f) in the spring; absent since a heavy defeat at Pontefract 263 days ago; only 1lb higher than for his latest win so he is worth a market check.

runners.breeder: S C E A Ecurie Haras Du Cadran Et Al
runners.comment: Two solid efforts following a wind op in November; needs more to win but it's possible
runners.name: Age Of Baroque
runners.spotlight: Never dangerous when eighth behind American State here last month, his first run after a wind operation; better effort when third at Southwell ten days ago (1m); not ruled out.

runners.comment: Three course wins this winter (7f, Class 6); well beaten on last two starts; others safer
runners.name: Harbour Vision
runners.spotlight: Prolific winner here down the years, including 7f wins in December, January and February; well beaten in Class 5 (saddle slipped) and Class 4 on his last two starts and only dropped 1lb; others appeal more.

runners.comment: Arrives in good form, including over C&D, and should be in the shake up once again
runners.name: Antiquity
runners.owner: P&h Moorhead J Collins And S Piper
runners.spotlight: He had finished second twice prior to his 1m Lingfield win last month; not beaten far at Chelmsford a fortnight ago (1m) and he should remain competitive.

runners.comment: Has been hinting at better of late and Rossa Ryan replaces an apprentice; check betting
runners.name: Moby Quick
runners.spotlight: 6f win for George Scott on turf last summer; edging down the weights for current stable while suggesting he retains a fair level of ability; Rossa Ryan replaces an apprentice this time; not discounted.

runners.comment: Beverley win (8.5f) last September; absent since lesser effort one month later
runners.name: Kiss Me My Love
runners.spotlight: Successful in a Beverley handicap at a similar trip last September; absent since a lesser effort at Nottingham one month later (raced freely having fluffed the start); remains capable of better at 1m+.

runners.comment: On a dangerous mark and Billy Loughnane's booking points to him raising his game today
runners.name: Youarenotforgiven
runners.spotlight: Two course wins (9.4f) last autumn and he is well handicapped again on that form; not firing on all cylinders more recently but Billy Loughnane's booking a clear hint that better may be forthcoming today.

runners.comment: Only sixth behind Marry The Night at Southwell on stable debut 16 days ago; more required
runners.name: Eagles Whistle
runners.spotlight: Won three classified events in the space of four days in January when trained by Daragh Bourke; didn't run badly back in a handicap 16 days ago (stable debut) but she was readily outpointed by Marry The Night; could be sharper today but she needs to be.

runners.comment: Two course wins last year; not fired yet in 2026 but back to his last winning mark
runners.name: Sceptic
runners.spotlight: Two course wins (7f and 9.4f) in 2025; has not found his best form so far this year but he is back to his last winning mark as a consequence.

18:30.race_name: Friday Night Live With SBK Handicap (Div II)

runners.comment: Two C&D wins as a 2yo; struggled in handicaps, including last month's return; risky
runners.name: Eazy On The Eye
runners.spotlight: Won two C&D events as a 2yo; struggled last year and her return to action at Kempton last month resulted in a heavy defeat; down in the weights but comes with risks attached.

runners.comment: No form of note in 2025 but tumbled down weights; returns in new headgear; check betting
runners.name: Present Times
runners.spotlight: 1m AW winner for Charlie Appleby as a 2yo; barely beat a rival in five handicap runs in 2025 (sold after the first of them) but he has tumbled down the weights and has his first run in 0-70 company with new headgear fitted; market confidence should be noted.

runners.comment: Conditions no problem and on his last winning mark; Jack Mitchell replaces a 7lb claimer
runners.name: Ernies Valentine
runners.spotlight: Seven times an AW winner, twice over C&D; back to his last winning mark and Jack Mitchell takes over from a 7lb claimer; one to take seriously.

runners.comment: Out of sorts for a while but latest run was more encouraging; revival could be imminent
runners.name: Eagle Day
runners.spotlight: Patchy record since winning a 9.4f handicap here in December 2024; however, that was when ridden by Rossa Ryan (form figures of 11312 when he has been aboard) and he is now 13lb lower; needs a revival but a return to positive tactics from stall 1 would seem likely and he is an interesting contender.

runners.comment: On a reduced mark but he will need to leave his reappearance well behind him
runners.name: Up The Jazz
runners.spotlight: His course win (9.4f) in November 2024 came off an 8lb higher mark; ended 2025 quietly and he was down the field on his reappearance at Newcastle last month (1m2f); more to prove than many.

runners.comment: Veteran who ended his 2025 campaign with two lesser efforts; others hold stronger claims
runners.name: Jewel Maker
runners.spotlight: Veteran with 12 wins to his name; ended 2025 with a couple of quiet efforts and others arrive with more pressing claims.

runners.comment: C&D win last month was followed by a good 2nd at Lingfield (7f); sneaking back up weights
runners.name: Poetic Force
runners.spotlight: 18th success of his long career when getting the better of Antiquity (winner since and runs in the 6.00) over C&D last month; bumped into an in-form opponent at Lingfield two weeks ago (7f; blinkered first time); another 2lb rise is not ideal but he is likely to give his running.

runners.comment: Mixed bag for new yard but best recent run was at this track; raced too freely yesterday
runners.name: Riyadh Gem
runners.spotlight: Won his first two handicaps when trained by Archie Watson (both Tapeta; 1m and 9.4f); three heavy defeats from his first four runs for new connections but the one good effort came here; raced too freely and effort fizzled out in the final furlong in a slowly run event at Newcastle yesterday.

runners.comment: Three turf wins last year; mark still fair but the absence of a tongue-tie is offputting
runners.name: Fire Eyes
runners.spotlight: Won three turf handicaps in 2025, all in a tongue-tie and the latest with cheekpieces on for the first time; has gone well after a break in the past but the absence of any accessories tempers enthusiasm.

runners.comment: Easy 1m win at Southwell last September; mixed record since; others make more appeal
runners.name: Coloane
runners.spotlight: Easy winner of a 1m handicap at Southwell last September when 9lb lower; up and down since and needs to be at her best to take this after 108 days off.

19:00.race_name: SBK: Dont Settle For Less Handicap

runners.comment: In career-best form prior to an outside draw on latest start; considered each-way
runners.name: Dukes Command
runners.spotlight: Hit career-best form over 1m/1m2f on three of his last four starts of 2025, including when third in a steadily run Listed event at Lingfield on New Year's Eve; outside draw may have prevented any chance of a repeat there three weeks ago and he's considered each-way.

runners.comment: 3-7 strike-rate; front-running second over C&D 13 days ago was another good effort
runners.name: First Principle
runners.spotlight: Winner of three of his seven starts and although he found one too good for him when front-running over C&D 13 days ago, that was another good effort; drawn a little wider this time but needs respect.

runners.comment: Hung badly right at this track (first visit) on latest start; new equipment today
runners.name: Superposition
runners.spotlight: Has usually run with credit on AW, including at left-handed Lingfield on penultimate start; something went wrong when he hung badly right at this track (first visit) on latest but he returns just 13 days later, fitted with a tongue-tie and hood both for the first time.

runners.comment: 3-6 strike-rate; came wide and late for a short-head win over C&D latest; off 132 days
runners.name: City Of Poets
runners.spotlight: Has looked quirky on occasions but he came wide and late for a short-head win (from Zryan) over C&D on latest outing, making it three wins from six starts; off 132 days since but raised just 3lb and needs major attention as one of the least exposed runners in this line-up.

runners.comment: Resurgent for new yard this year; won by 2l from Zryan at Southwell (1m, Tapeta) on latest
runners.name: Dosman
runners.spotlight: Resurgent for new yard this year, looking unlucky at Newcastle on penultimate start and handing a 2l beating to runner-up Zryan at Southwell (again 1m, Tapeta) on latest; back up another 4lb but the best of his old form was a little better still and he has to be on the shortlist.

runners.comment: Second to Dosman at Southwell last time and should be seriously involved again
runners.name: Zryan
runners.spotlight: Arrived from France last summer and has been competitive on most starts since, including wins this winter over C&D and Newcastle's 1m2f; second to Dosman at Southwell last time and should be seriously involved again.

runners.comment: Going well for new stable; won in clearcut style at Kempton (1m) last time; up 5lb
runners.name: Advancing
runners.spotlight: Won stable debut over C&D in December, bang there on next two starts and scored again at Kempton (1m) on latest; did it in clearcut style last time, which has earned him a 5lb rise but he remains one to take seriously.

runners.comment: No show when favourite in the Southwell race won by Dosman last time; cheekpieces removed
runners.name: Unassuming
runners.spotlight: Latest win was C&D in October and she twice went close in November; ran respectably on next four starts but no show when favourite in the Southwell race won by Dosman on latest; cheekpieces (worn last three outings) are removed.

runners.comment: Ended 2025 with a modest sequence; absent 175 days and gelded
runners.name: Thunder Wonder
runners.spotlight: Won at Musselburgh last April/June; now 5lb below last winning mark, having ended 2025 with a modest sequence; absent 175 days and gelded.

runners.comment: Not so hot on last three runs; absent 160 days and her only AW run (last April) was modest
runners.name: Perfect Part
runners.spotlight: Pretty useful last March-June but not so hot on last three outings; absent 160 days and her only AW run (last April) was modest.

runners.comment: Significant ability remains compared to this reduced mark; more to prove at this AW track
runners.name: Penzance
runners.spotlight: Five AW wins (latest last March) when trained by Mick Appleby and significant ability remains compared to this reduced mark; however, more to prove at Wolverhampton than other AW tracks.

runners.comment: 7-28 on Dundalk AW, with his latest win this January; others look a bit better handicapped
runners.name: Exquisite Acclaim
runners.owner: Thomas J OConnor & Ms Hazel McGuinness
runners.spotlight: 7-28 on the Dundalk AW, with his latest win this January and that's his clear highlight this winter; the last year suggests that others will be a bit better handicapped.

runners.comment: Unexposed after three races but opposable after a disappointing handicap debut in December
runners.name: Moon Beginnings
runners.owner: Nbr30 Mike Owen & Rasio Cymru Racing
runners.spotlight: Won 7f novice at Chester in September on debut; second at odds-on at Southwell (1m, AW) in November but disappointing on handicap debut at Newcastle (also 1m on Tapeta) in December; unexposed but opposable after latest run.

runners.comment: Tailed off on reappearance for new stable last month; now tongue tied first time
runners.name: Kind Of Kiss
runners.spotlight: 1m2f French winner; not far away on several outings for Kevin Philippart De Foy but ended his time with that yard on a low note and tailed off on reappearance for new stable last month; now tongue tied first time.

runners.comment: Two 1m2f novice wins; favourite for handicap debut (1m4f) but failed to settle
runners.name: Spanish Voice
runners.spotlight: Pretty useful form to win 1m2f novice events at Newmarket last April and Lingfield (AW) last month, having been absent in between; favourite for handicap debut at Kempton, which didn't not go well but he failed to settle on that step up to 1m4f; should be of interest at this trip.

runners.comment: Formerly useful on the Flat but best watched on the more recent evidence
runners.name: Marhaba The Champ
runners.spotlight: Formerly useful on the Flat for Kevin Ryan but was sold last July and has been comfortably held since on the Flat and over hurdles, last seen in November; ran moderately in 2024 on his only appearance on AW.

runners.comment: Made all under Olivia Tubb in a six-runner race over C&D 13 days ago; wide draw today
runners.name: Way Of Life
runners.spotlight: His first seven wins were all gained over 1m4f/1m3f, with the latest of those last October, but he then made all under Olivia Tubb in a six-runner race over C&D 13 days ago; that win was by a neck and he's been raised 2lb since, but a wide draw complicates today's task.

runners.comment: Progressive form in his four maidens; gelded since; likely to stay and bring potential
runners.name: Fierce Fortitude
runners.spotlight: Progressive form in his four maidens, culminating in September in his second at Newcastle (7f, Tapeta) and his win in a four-runner race at Brighton (7f, good to firm); gelded since; likely to stay and bring potential to this handicap debut and his strength in the market can prove instructive.

runners.comment: First hood and 251 days off when he nearly won stable debut at Lingfield (1m2f, AW; 16-1)
runners.name: Metallo
runners.spotlight: 1-12 for Jack Channon, with the win in a 2023 maiden; first-time hood and 251 days off when he nearly improved that strike-rate at Lingfield (1m2f, AW; 16-1) last month, finishing well from off the pace, in a blanket finish admittedly but he looks to be of major renewed interest.

runners.comment: Creditable third at Newcastle on latest outing suggests that the handicapper has caught up
runners.name: Without Compromise
runners.spotlight: All his three wins were over 1m2f at Newcastle last October-December, easily on last occasion, but his creditable third there on latest outing suggests that the handicapper has caught up.

runners.comment: Respectable last two starts; it remains to be seen whether this step up in trip will suit
runners.name: High On Hope
runners.spotlight: 1m Polytrack wins at Chelmsford and Kempton in January; respectable fifth in Class 2 events on last two starts, including over 8.6f here 13 days ago but it remains to be seen whether this step up in trip will suit him.

runners.comment: Lightly raced; second handicap and he leaves impression there's more improvement in him
runners.name: My Fermoy
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the fifth attempt, in emphatic fashion when evens for a Southwell novice (1m, AW) in November; set a steady pace on handicap debut at Lingfield (1m2f) three months ago but lost out in the final 1f, still a good effort in second of six; carries his head a little awkwardly but leaves the impression there is more improvement in him.

runners.comment: Seven-race maiden; plenty of ability from the onset but latest start was his worst effort
runners.name: Criminal
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; plenty of ability from the word go but latest start was his worst effort, when seventh of eight at Kempton (1m3f) with 7lb claimer enlisted; trip rethink after all handicaps have been at 1m2f-1m4f.

runners.comment: Placed in Class 4 on last three outings; highly reliable and again brings each-way claims
runners.name: Jez Bomb
runners.spotlight: Had four (two here) wins in 2024 and another four last April-October; none of those were above Class 5 but he's been placed in Class 4 on last three outings and this highly reliable sort again brings each-way claims.

runners.comment: May be on her way back but this is a warmer race than the one she won 16 days ago
runners.name: Bint Al Daar
runners.spotlight: Mostly well below form in 2025 but came back down the weights and has often been competitive since October; indeed, Southwell (1m3f, Tapeta) 16 days ago saw her first win since a C&D race in summer 2024; it's possible that she is on her way back but this is a warmer contest.

runners.comment: Below par at Meydan this year; otherwise has a solid record (222132) in British races
runners.name: One More
runners.spotlight: Has failed to fire in two Meydan outings this year; otherwise has a solid record (222132) in British races, mostly at Kempton; may rebound, provided he takes to Wolverhampton.

runners.comment: Ended his 2025 campaign with C&D win and went close at Newcastle on reappearance
runners.name: The Dragon King
runners.spotlight: Ended his 2025 campaign with a C&D success and went close, posting a career-best RPR, at Newcastle (7f) on reappearance; still unexposed on AW and over this trip; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Form dipped sharply after last success; big rebound is needed
runners.name: Bellarchi
runners.spotlight: Scored four times (AW/turf) in 2025 but her form dipped sharply after the final success; big rebound is needed on reappearance.

runners.comment: Solid effort at Southwell (on only second start for new yard and on AW) last time
runners.name: I Still Have Faith
runners.owner: J Morley D Reynolds C Watkins & Partner
runners.spotlight: No win since 2023; however, has plenty of fairly useful form, including a solid effort over 7f at Southwell (on only second start for new yard and on AW) last time; in the mix.

runners.breeder: D & S L Tanker Transport Ltd
runners.comment: Inconsistent since last win; steps back up in trip; not sure what to expect
runners.name: Intervention
runners.spotlight: Gained last three wins over 6f; has proved inconsistent since the most recent one; previously effective at 7f but whether he'll turn up in top form is difficult to ascertain.

runners.breeder: Haras De Saint Julien & Mme Regula Vanno
runners.comment: Inconsistent sort; just one win in Britain; not sure to back up latest effort
runners.name: Society Man
runners.spotlight: Gained sole British success in Kempton event in October off 3lb higher; inconsistent otherwise and is by no means certain to back up latest effort (ran respectably).

runners.comment: Reappearance defeat took his record since debut win to 0-8
runners.name: An Outlaws Grace
runners.spotlight: Last of seven at Lingfield (6f) on AW/seasonal debut, taking record since debut win to 0-8; best watched unless the market suggests a bigger effort is likely.

runners.comment: Steadily progressive on turf; has bits of encouraging AW form; commands respect
runners.name: Pietro
runners.spotlight: Steadily progressive on turf, winning three times; good second at Yarmouth (7f) when last seen; may continue to improve this term; has bits of encouraging AW form; commands respect.

runners.comment: Ran with promise at Wolverhampton on AW/seasonal debut; well treated on best turf form
runners.name: Dragon Leader
runners.spotlight: Seen only twice since 2024 but ran with promise over 6f at Wolverhampton (AW debut) last time, shaping as if this return to 7f will suit; well handicapped on best turf form, which features two notable wins as a 2yo; interesting.

runners.comment: First attempt at Wolverhampton coincides with tongue-tie replacing usual hood
runners.name: Metaverse
runners.spotlight: Has shown most of his AW form at Kempton but ran creditably at Southwell most recently; makes Wolverhampton debut with a tongue-tie replacing usual hood; brings uncertainty.

runners.comment: Won with a bit in hand on stable/seasonal debut; attempted Class 2 last time
runners.name: North View
runners.spotlight: Won with a bit in hand at Chelmsford (7f) on stable/seasonal debut; out of the money in two starts since but can't be written off yet; drops back in grade (attempted Class 2 latest).

runners.breeder: S C E A Marmion Vauville Et Al
runners.comment: Sound effort over C&D on seasonal debut; has Oisin Murphy up for first time; good chance
runners.name: Pressures On
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful on AW and turf; ran creditably off top weight over C&D on seasonal debut, beating all bar an unexposed sort who headed the betting; receives weight all round in this field and has Oisin Murphy up for first time; good chance.

20:30.race_name: SBK: No Casino Just Sports Handicap

runners.comment: Course winner last week but a penalty leaves him 2lb badly in
runners.name: Moulin Booj
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly over 5f but the manner of his course win (5f) last week suggests he'll be as effective back at 6f; whether he can defy a 5lb penalty is a different matter (2lb badly in).

runners.comment: Remains weighted to the hilt (on career-high mark)
runners.name: Valley Ofthe Kings
runners.spotlight: Dual sprint winner who didn't see out 7f as well as the horse who beat him at Kempton most recently; return to 6f looks a plus but he remains weighted to the hilt (on career-high mark).

runners.comment: On a difficult mark and has done his winning on turf
runners.name: Marching Mac
runners.spotlight: On a difficult mark and has done all of his winning on turf, mostly over shorter than 6f; mixed RPRs since returned to AW; not the percentage call in this competitive race.

runners.breeder: Mrs Mary Taylor And James F Taylor
runners.comment: Made all at Windsor when last seen and remains unexposed over 6f; new stable
runners.name: Seraphim Angel
runners.spotlight: Three wins on turf for Tom Dascombe, making all at Windsor (6f) when last seen eight months ago; remains less exposed at this trip than 5f; market confidence would heighten interest.

runners.comment: Justified favouritism at Chelmsford on AW/stable/seasonal debut; type to improve further
runners.name: Arklow Lad
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 4yo who justified favouritism at Chelmsford (5f) on AW/stable/seasonal debut, taking record to 2-7; looks likely to be as effective back over 6f (second attempt); respected with further progress plausible.

runners.comment: Remains in form but likely needs to raise his game in this field
runners.name: Buccabay
runners.spotlight: Opened his AW account in Kempton contest (6f) in December; has remained in form since, without necessarily building on that success; likely needs to raise his game in this field.

runners.comment: Takes on several last-time winners who have younger legs
runners.name: Aberama Gold
runners.spotlight: Retains quite a useful level of ability despite his advancing years but form dipped last time; on a 14-race losing sequence and takes on several last-time winners who have younger legs.

runners.comment: Took well to first-time blinkers (retained) over C&D when last seen; unexposed on AW
runners.name: King Of Bears
runners.spotlight: Absent since winning in first-time blinkers (retained) over C&D three months ago on second start for new yard and on AW; unexposed in this sphere and still has leeway in the handicap (peak mark was 16lb higher).

runners.comment: On a tough mark but is reasonably solid and likely to give his running
runners.name: Papa Cocktail
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly over C&D since October, winning twice in Class 5; creditable third in Class 4 event most recently; on a tough mark but is reasonably solid and likely to give his running.

runners.comment: Big player under a small penalty for his latest Newcastle win; future mark 5lb higher
runners.name: Grant Wood
runners.spotlight: Won going away last week, completing a Newcastle double (6f) and taking AW record to 4-10 (2-2 this year); in excellent form and well handicapped under a small penalty (future mark 5lb higher); big player.

runners.comment: Irish 4yo who has form figures of 1243 since being gelded; each-way squeak
runners.name: Dark Ace
runners.owner: J Fairhurst & Damian McCann & Cyril McMullan
runners.spotlight: Irish 4yo whose strike-rate is 3-14; has form figures of 1243 since being gelded, the success on turf and other efforts on Dundalk AW (dual winner there previously); each-way squeak on seasonal debut.

runners.breeder: S A S Ecurie De Cachene & Earl Haras D
runners.comment: Has something to find on the balance of his recent 7f form
runners.name: Tennessee Gold
runners.spotlight: Shapes as if this return to 6f is worth a shot but otherwise has something to find on the balance of his recent 7f form and losing sequence goes back to 2024; others have stronger claims.

runners.comment: Promising second on hurdle debut in December; backwards step last time but wind op since
runners.name: Alsakib
runners.spotlight: 1m6f Group 3 winner on the Flat in 2024; promising second on hurdle/stable debut at Wetherby (2m, soft) in December; took backwards step at Catterick (2m3f, good to soft) in January but has had wind surgery since and he's a key player if back on song; versatile ground-wise.

runners.comment: Not devoid of promise on bumper debut in December but well beaten on his three runs since
runners.name: Dublinofficecallin
runners.spotlight: Not devoid of promise on bumper debut at Catterick in December but well beaten on his three starts since, the last two over hurdles at big prices; a transformation is needed in a first-time hood.

runners.comment: Tailed off in two of his three bumpers but encouraging third in between; hurdle debut
runners.name: Last Man Standing
runners.spotlight: Tailed off on two of his three bumper starts but in between this brother to useful 2m3f-3m1f hurdle/chase winner Hidden History was third of 11 at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft), and he's an each-way contender if rediscovering that promise now switched to hurdles.

runners.comment: Some useful form on the Flat and he brings potential to this hurdle debut; check betting
runners.name: Lyric
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo; well beaten last May on sole Flat start for this yard but he has some useful form in that sphere and brings potential to this hurdle debut; interesting to see how he goes in the betting in a modest race.

runners.comment: 0-4 on the Flat and tailed off at 66-1 on hurdle debut at Newcastle four weeks ago
runners.name: Ned Broy
runners.spotlight: A couple of hints of ability in four-race Flat career but tailed off at 66-1 on hurdle debut at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft) four weeks ago.

runners.comment: Course Flat winner who was second at Kelso on second hurdle start; he's high on the list
runners.name: Quercus Robur
runners.spotlight: Won on the Flat here (2m, soft) in November; fourth on hurdle debut here (1m7f, good to soft) later that month and improved when runner-up at Kelso (2m, good to soft) in December; he's high on the list today.

runners.comment: 0-10 over hurdles and returns from a break, but he's firmly in the mix on his best form
runners.name: Scriabin
runners.spotlight: Made it 0-10 over hurdles when soundly beaten in handicap at Perth (2m, good) last September when last seen; however, prior to that he was third in a maiden hurdle at Perth (2m, good) in August on his stable debut and he'll be firmly in the mix if rediscovering that form.

runners.comment: Remote when third in a point last May and she's struggled at big odds on her 3 hurdle runs
runners.name: Breaking Ground
runners.spotlight: Remote when third in a point last May and she's struggled at big odds on her first three hurdle starts; she's hard to fancy.

runners.comment: Made the frame over 7f/1m on the Flat but well beaten at big odds on both hurdle runs
runners.name: Storm The Dug
runners.spotlight: Made the frame over 7f/1m on the Flat but well beaten at big odds on both hurdle runs and needs to be an entirely different proposition today.

runners.comment: 3rd in three mares' bumpers and open to improvement; might not be far away on hurdle debut
runners.name: Luna Grace
runners.spotlight: 4yo who has finished third in mares' bumpers on her three starts (2m, good/soft/AW); has appeared to be a work in progress and she's open to improvement; might not be far away on hurdle debut.

14:50.race_name: Heritage Portfolio Never Standing Still Novices' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Newcastle win (2m4f, good to soft) last time, coming from the rear to justify favouritism
runners.name: Big Storm Brewing
runners.spotlight: Seems best away from soft ground; off the mark (tenth attempt) in a 12-runner novice handicap at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) 17 days ago, coming from the rear to justify favouritism under 7lb claimer, and the way she did it gives hope for this new trip; back up 5lb but one to note.

runners.comment: Made all at Newcastle (3m, heavy) in January, which is some way clear of his other form
runners.name: Parish Quiz
runners.spotlight: Made all at Newcastle (3m, heavy; 5lb higher today) in January but that's some way clear of his other form; third to a wide-margin winner back at Newcastle (good to soft) on latest outing; case rests on one piece of form.

runners.comment: Effective over C&D; creditable third to Big Storm Brewing latest; hurdles score is 0-14
runners.name: Leader Wing
runners.spotlight: Lost out in a tight finish over C&D (soft) in December and creditable third to Big Storm Brewing at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft; fine on good ground) on latest outing; hurdles score has gone to 0-14, though.

runners.comment: 0-17 as a hurdler; a hood returns, after it was last fitted in 2023
runners.name: Anamanda
runners.spotlight: Went close at Kelso (2m5f, good) last April but has not made a serious impact this season; now 8lb below the Kelso mark but 0-17 as a hurdler; a hood returns, after it was last fitted in 2023.

runners.comment: Grim results in his four handicaps; moves up from 2m4f and has headgear first time
runners.name: Sams Falcon
runners.spotlight: He hasn't had a lot of racing but there have been grim results to his four handicaps; moves up from 2m4f and has headgear first time.

runners.comment: Fourth over C&D on latest outing; hurdles score is 23 races with no wins and no seconds
runners.name: Dr Shirocco
runners.spotlight: Two of his four chase wins were at Musselburgh and he wasn't disgraced here when fourth in a C&D hurdle race on latest outing; however, it's hard to ignore that his hurdles score is 23 races with no wins and no seconds.

runners.breeder: R D And Mrs J S Chugg
runners.comment: Won just one (a hurdle race last May) of 47 races and today he is 3lb out of the handicap
runners.name: Blended Stealth
runners.owner: D Mullen & Exors Of G Barker
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Sedgefield in November and not disgraced on penultimate start, but those are the only bright spots in his last nine races; reverts from chasing (last five starts); overall he's won just one (a hurdle race last May) of 47 and today he is 3lb out of the handicap.

15:22.race_name: Racing Post+ Subscription Go North Sea Pigeon Hurdle Series Final (A Handicap Hurdle) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: 2 wins here in January; pulled up in Imperial Cup since; could play leading role back here
runners.name: Star Of Guiting
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in the Imperial Cup at Sandown (2m, soft) only 13 days ago but he went there on a hat-trick following two wins here (1m7f, good to soft) in January; this unexposed 5yo could bounce back and play a leading role now back here and returned to better ground.

runners.comment: Won two in a row this winter and latest run, when well beaten, perhaps came too soon
runners.name: Haarar
runners.spotlight: Well beaten at Catterick last month but perhaps that run came too soon, just six days after he completed a double in good style at Carlisle (2m1f, good to soft); third in this last year and he could be involved.

runners.comment: Unexposed 7yo who has won two of his last three and is respected up 6lb for last time
runners.name: Light Fandango
runners.spotlight: Won at Doncaster (2m, good) in December on second start back from long absence and, after fading over 2m4f on soft next time, he won back at Doncaster (2m, good to soft) three weeks ago, when he was disputing the lead when left clear at the final flight; this unexposed 7yo is respected up 6lb.

runners.comment: Two ready wins at Kelso in the autumn but well below that level on her three starts since
runners.name: Magnolia
runners.spotlight: Two ready wins at Kelso (2m, good/soft) in the autumn but well below that level on her three starts since; needs to get back on track; the cheekpieces had no positive impact when used previously in France in 2024.

runners.comment: Won over C&D on handicap debut in November but form has gone the wrong way since
runners.name: City Of Diamonds
runners.spotlight: Beat Star Of Guiting to win over C&D (good to soft) on handicap debut in November but form has gone the wrong way on his three runs since.

runners.comment: 10yo who is on a reduced mark but needs to build on his recent third at Ayr
runners.name: Ginger Mail
runners.owner: Mrs David Coltman & Mrs J Douglas Miller
runners.spotlight: 10yo whose mark continues to fall and he took a step back in the right direction when third of seven at Ayr a fortnight ago; it's possible he'll be able to build on that latest run but he was beaten just over 7l and certainly needs a bigger performance this afternoon.

runners.comment: Third at Kelso last month following wind surgery and he's in with an each-way shout
runners.name: Admiralty House
runners.spotlight: 0-11 since winning on hurdle debut in October 2022 but he ran pretty well when third at Kelso (2m, heavy) last month following wind surgery; he's in with an each-way shout if backing up that latest performance.

runners.comment: Runner-up in this last year; patchy form since latest win but no surprise if he runs well
runners.name: Heart Above
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in this last year and he won two in a row at Kelso (2m2f/2m5f, good/good to soft) in the autumn; patchy form since but when pulled up at Kelso last time he was contesting the very competitive Morebattle Hurdle; drying ground will aid his cause and it will be no surprise if he runs well.

runners.comment: Just 1-16 over hurdles but some reasonable form over C&D this year; not ruled out each-way
runners.name: Ravenscraig Castle
runners.owner: A Sinclair I Jardine & V Renwick
runners.spotlight: Sole win over hurdles, from 16 attempts, came at Perth (2m, good) last July; ran okay over C&D in January on his last two hurdle starts (good to soft) and is not ruled out each-way.

runners.comment: 2-2 in this visor prior to 9l third at Carlisle; today's sharper track may help
runners.name: Vampire Slayer
runners.spotlight: Won in a first-time visor (retained since) at Catterick (1m7f, soft) in January and easily made all at Sedgefield (2m1f, good to soft) next time; having gone up 9lb he was beaten 9l when third of 14 at Carlisle (2m1f, soft) last time but today's sharper track may help; could make bold bid.

runners.comment: Twice went close in first half of season but has failed to threaten on last three starts
runners.name: Book Of Secrets
runners.spotlight: Twice went close in the first half of the season and he's on a handy mark on that form; however, he's failed to threaten on his last three starts and has to raise his game.

runners.comment: Below par at Doncaster latest but her previous second over this C&D reads well; contender
runners.name: As Fast As Wind
runners.spotlight: Her jumping can lack fluency and soundly beaten behind Light Fandango at Doncaster (2m, good to soft) last month; however, prior to that she kept on from the rear to finish second over this C&D (good to soft) and that form has worked out well; today's big-field scenario should suit; contender.

runners.comment: Went close over C&D in December and in good form in AW classified races of late
runners.name: Gemini Man
runners.spotlight: Went close behind progressive winner over C&D (good to soft) in December; only sixth over C&D (good to soft) next time but he's been in good form in AW classified races since and is one to consider.

runners.comment: Heavy ground maybe didn't suit last time; well treated on last February's course form
runners.name: Travis Wheatley
runners.spotlight: He has to produce more than he's managed on his three starts this season but heavy ground may not have suited when back down to 2m at Kelso last month; his best performance came when fourth in a warm little novice here (1m7f, good to soft) last February and he's well treated on that evidence.

runners.comment: Returned to form when third at Carlisle but needs to build on that in this hotter race
runners.name: Disco Annie
runners.spotlight: Having dropped to a career-low mark she returned to form when third in first-time cheekpieces (retained) at Carlisle 12 days ago; however, she's in a hotter race today and needs to build on that latest performance.

15:55.race_name: Heritage Portfolio Go North Night Nurse Series Final Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Made it 2-5 over hurdles in 2m4f novice at Newcastle recently; respected on handicap debut
runners.name: Sanilam
runners.owner: J Fyffe And Mrs W Duffus
runners.spotlight: Off the mark over hurdles at the third attempt at Ayr (2m, soft) in January and improved again when returning to winning ways at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) recently having been upped in trip in a first-time hood (retained); unexposed at this distance and he's respected on handicap debut.

runners.comment: Below par at Ayr last time but runner-up over this C&D previously in his sole handicap
runners.name: The G Wizard
runners.spotlight: Better could have been expected in a maiden at Ayr last time but prior to that he was second of 12 over this C&D (good to soft) on his handicap debut, and he can be in the mix if returning to form.

runners.comment: Disappointing last time but not written off on handicap debut in view of previous promise
runners.name: Loulou Madrik
runners.spotlight: Second at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) in January and again ran well when third there (2m4f, soft) 12 days later; reportedly never travelling when well beaten in first-time cheekpieces at Catterick (3m1f, soft) last month, but not written off in first-time tongue-tie/visor on handicap debut.

runners.comment: Lame when pulled up on handicap debut; this Catterick novice winner could bounce back
runners.name: Noonetellsmenothin
runners.spotlight: Lame when pulled up on last month's handicap debut at Kelso (2m6f, heavy); won on hurdle debut at Catterick (2m3f, good to soft) in December before no match for two useful sorts there (2m3f, good to soft); could bounce back with good run in first-time cheekpieces now back on better ground.

runners.breeder: S C E A Ste Ent Etienne Et Gregoire Lee
runners.comment: The only one to give the favourite a race at Ayr; may well have potential off opening mark
runners.name: Linalene
runners.spotlight: Best performance yet when the only one to give the odds-on winner a race in Ayr novice (2m, soft) last month; finished close-up in good-ground bumper; on that latest evidence he may well have potential off his opening mark.

runners.comment: Tailed off last time but promise on first two hurdle runs; not discounted now in handicap
runners.name: Whos Glen
runners.spotlight: He could do with settling better than when tailed off in Doncaster maiden (2m3f, soft) last month; however, he was very talented on the Flat in his prime and showed some promise on his first two hurdle starts (2m4f/2m1f, good to soft); not discounted now tackling his first handicap hurdle.

runners.breeder: S C E A Ecurie Cap Orne
runners.comment: Stable is in better form now than when he contested his first two handicaps in January
runners.name: Kool Raoul
runners.spotlight: He needs to produce more than he managed in January in his first two handicaps, but his stable was just 1-62 with jumpers that month; his yard is in much better form now and he showed promise in novice/maiden hurdles towards the end of last year; interesting contender.

runners.comment: Underwhelming at Doncaster last time but encouraging signs previously and not ruled out
runners.name: Killycarn
runners.spotlight: Underwhelming at Doncaster (2m, good to soft) last time but encouraging signs previously, winning on handicap debut at Catterick (1m7f, good) then sixth of 17 at Haydock (2m5f, good to soft) when fading late on; this sharp 2m4f could be a good fit and he's not ruled out.

runners.comment: Runner-up on handicap debut at Catterick and he's open to improvement; possible player
runners.name: Abbey Scope
runners.spotlight: Good-ground bumper winner who ran best race yet over hurdles when runner-up on handicap debut at Catterick (2m3f, soft) last time; open to improvement, including with his jumping, and he's a possible player.

runners.comment: 4yo; stayed well on the Flat and not discounted now up in trip on handicap hurdle debut
runners.name: Keyboard
runners.spotlight: 4yo who may not be straightforward and was disappointing when odds-on at Kelso (2m, good to soft) three weeks ago; however, before that he was second on his first three hurdle starts (1m7f, good to soft; two here); stayed well on the Flat and not discounted now up in trip on handicap hurdle debut.

runners.comment: 12lb higher than at Carlisle last week but did it easily and may well have more to offer
runners.name: Queen Roslyn
runners.spotlight: From out of the handicap she's 12lb higher than when winning at Carlisle (2m1f, soft) 12 days ago in her second handicap hurdle; however, she did it comfortably and may well have more to offer in this code, especially now up in trip (won at up to 2m on the Flat); versatile ground-wise.

16:30.race_name: Racing Post+ Ultimate Go North Brindisi Breeze Hurdle Series Final (A Handicap Hurdle) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Made very good start for new yard; disappointing at Ayr last time but could bounce back
runners.name: Authorized Mission
runners.spotlight: Easy win on stable debut at Kelso (2m5f, good to soft) in November and runner-up to progressive winner there (extended 2m6f, soft) next time; disappointing at Ayr (3m, soft) at the start of January but has had a break since and could bounce back with a bold show today.

runners.comment: Won two in a row at Perth in the autumn; below par on both runs since but not written off
runners.name: Spit Spot
runners.spotlight: Course maiden winner who won two in a row at Perth (3m, good/soft) in the autumn before lesser show at Ascot (2m7f, good) in November; again soundly beaten at Haydock (3m, good to soft) a fortnight ago following a break but she may have needed that run and is not written off.

runners.comment: Completed double with C&D win in January; another good run since; she's one to consider
runners.name: Snowrocco
runners.spotlight: Won at Newcastle (2m7f, good to soft) in December and followed up over this C&D (good to soft), again easily; having gone up the weights she was fourth at Market Rasen (2m4f, soft) last time but that was still a good run in a warm mares' handicap and she's one to consider today.

runners.comment: Runner-up on handicap debut at Kelso in October but hasn't progressed in two runs since
runners.name: Lets Mingle
runners.spotlight: Won small-field maiden hurdle at Perth (2m4f, good) last May and runner-up on handicap debut at Kelso (2m6f, good) in October; however, she's failed to progress on her two subsequent outings and improvement is needed.

runners.comment: Hopes are pinned on blinkers prompting major revival; cheekpieces worked well last spring
runners.name: Kilmore Rock
runners.spotlight: It's been a major struggle on his five starts since last June; however, he won three in a row last spring (2m6f-3m1f, good) when the cheekpieces first went on and perhaps there will be a positive reaction now blinkers are applied; he's 3lb below his last winning mark; not a forlorn hope.

runners.comment: Tailed off over hurdles last time but won over fences here in December when 2lb higher
runners.name: Forged Well
runners.owner: Mrs Suzy Brown & Peter R Brown
runners.spotlight: Tailed off when back over hurdles at Sedgefield last month and something to prove after that; however, he's 2lb lower than for his ready win over fences here (2m7f, good to soft) in December and shouldn't be discounted.

runners.comment: Rejuvenated 12yo who made all at Doncaster on final two runs in 2025; returns from break
runners.name: Romeo Brown
runners.spotlight: 12yo who exploited a career-low mark in reapplied cheekpieces (retained since) at Doncaster (3m, good to soft) in November and followed up there (3m, good to soft) in December, making all under Oscar Palmer each time; he's a player if resuming where he left off.

runners.comment: Two wins in 2025; not running badly this year but needs something extra today
runners.name: Follow Charlie
runners.spotlight: Won at Perth (2m4f, good) last May and at Ayr (2m4f, soft) in November, and has run well at up to 3m; now just 1lb above his last winning mark and not running badly this year, but he has to better those recent efforts.

runners.breeder: Mme Philippe Morruzzi & Mr Philippe Morr
runners.comment: Won over C&D last month and 8l second to thriving winner at Sedgefield since; progressive
runners.name: Dearkeithandkaty
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt in handicaps over C&D (good to soft) last month and 8l second to thriving winner at Sedgefield (2m4f, soft) subsequently; this unexposed 5yo is in good hands to continue to progress.

runners.comment: Back to form with clear second at Catterick last month following wind op; headgear change
runners.name: Monsieur Le Fuzz
runners.spotlight: Following wind surgery he left this season's form well behind to finish a clear second at Catterick (3m1f, good to soft) last month; he can be involved if backing up that latest effort; a visor replaces cheekpieces.

runners.comment: 14l second over 3m at Doncaster last time and today's sharper track could be a positive
runners.name: Scairp Dubh
runners.spotlight: Won at Carlisle (2m3f, soft) last month on third handicap start and 14l second of seven at Doncaster (3m, good to soft) 13 days later; kept to a similar trip, today's sharper track could be a positive, and this lightly raced 6yo wears first-time cheekpieces; remains open to improvement.

runners.comment: C&D winner last February but has failed to shine on his three outings since November
runners.name: Evenwood Sonofagun
runners.owner: Mrs D Chapman & Mrs E Quinlan
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D (good to soft) last February and add two wins at Cartmel in May; he's 6lb below his last winning mark but has failed to shine on his three outings since November, over C&D most recently.

runners.comment: Won easily at Ayr last month but it's disconcerting he was pulled up at Newcastle since
runners.name: Better Be Definite
runners.spotlight: Won easily at Ayr last month on third start back from a long absence and on that evidence today's 7lb higher mark should be within range; not written off but disconcerting he was pulled up at Newcastle last time.

runners.comment: 3lb out of the handicap but running well since December, twice going close over C&D
runners.name: Bollin Matilda
runners.spotlight: She's 3lb out of the handicap but has been running well since December, twice going close over C&D (good to soft/soft); each-way possible.

runners.comment: Fourth of 15 in this last year but not at top of his game more recently and he's now 0-31
runners.name: Star Vantage
runners.spotlight: From out of the handicap he's 2lb higher than when running well in fourth of 15 (good to soft) in this race 12 months ago; however, he hasn't been at the top of his game more recently and is now 0-31.

runners.comment: Won at Ludlow then good second at Market Rasen; progressive and holds very solid claims
runners.name: Railway Bell
runners.spotlight: Made it 3-4 under rules when winning at Ludlow (2m, good to soft) in January on second handicap start and good second at Market Rasen (2m4f, soft) subsequently; this progressive 7yo holds very solid claims.

runners.comment: Three wins last spring; fourth over C&D in November when last seen; each-way claims
runners.name: Feach Amach
runners.spotlight: Won three times last spring (2m4f/2m5f, good/good to soft); ran okay when fourth of seven over C&D (good to soft) in November when last seen (lost a shoe); each-way claims if fully tuned up after a break.

runners.comment: Return to form required but may have needed latest run and she's off her last winning mark
runners.name: Spot On Soph
runners.spotlight: Tailed off at Market Rasen in November and same story at Catterick last month on her sole run since; however, she may have needed that latest outing and runs off the same mark as for her win at Sedgefield (2m4f, good) in September; yard's horses are running well and she's not discounted.

runners.comment: Up and down in novice hurdles but posted 125-1 win; might not be far away if back on song
runners.name: Just An Artist
runners.spotlight: Up and down in novice hurdles and tailed off last time; however, she was a winner at 125-1 at Perth (2m, soft) in October and ran well in third at Carlisle (2m3f, good to soft) two starts ago; she might not be far away on this handicap debut if she's back on song.

runners.comment: Returned from absence with C&D second in maiden hurdle; could be a contender
runners.name: Tuppence
runners.spotlight: Returned from a year off in maiden hurdle over C&D (good to soft) last month and ran best race yet, finishing second in a first-time hood (retained); open to improvement, especially with her jumping, and she could be a contender now going handicapping for her respected stable.

runners.comment: Poor strike-rate but early days with this yard and has shown promise; has each-way shout
runners.name: Cher Tara
runners.spotlight: Just one win from her 19 starts but she was a close third of 16 at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) in January on her second outing for this yard; failed to build on that when third of five over this C&D (soft) since but she wasn't seen to best effect in that slowly run race; has an each-way shout.

runners.comment: Improvement possible on h'cap debut and she's one to watch in the betting now up in trip
runners.name: Berwick Law
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced 5yo whose dam was useful over fences in France; she hasn't achieved much across her four starts but improvement is possible on handicap debut and she's one to watch in the betting now up in trip.

runners.comment: Improving novice who was withdrawn at Cheltenham last week; sets the standard
runners.name: Came From Nowhere
runners.spotlight: Returns to a novice after running in handicaps, improving for the tongue-tie to win at Hereford (about 2m4f) and Ascot (about 2m3f, also soft); it was easily a career best last time and has since had a wind operation; sets the standard on RPRs; withdrawn from last week's Grade 1 novice at Cheltenham due to the drying ground; yard won this with Dashel Drasher in 2019.

runners.comment: Catterick winner; this is a harder race than that and he's penalised
runners.name: Itsinthename
runners.spotlight: Placed in a bumper for a different yard (same colours) before narrowly winning a Catterick maiden (1m7f, good to soft; new tongue-tie) on his first run for Nick Scholfield; this is a harder race than that and he's penalised.

runners.breeder: Mrs Sandra Cozenot & Mr Herve Cozenot
runners.comment: Came clear with the useful runner-up when justifying short odds in a maiden at Chepstow
runners.name: Le Frimeur
runners.spotlight: Harry Derham is seeking a hat-trick in this race and his Irish point winner (good to yielding) came clear with the useful runner-up when justifying short odds in a maiden at Chepstow (2m3f, soft); looks a good prospect.

runners.comment: Ran okay in a bumper but tailed off in two runs over hurdles; this is no easier
runners.name: Agent Argylle
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner; ran okay in a bumper but tailed off in two runs over hurdles; this is no easier.

runners.comment: Clear of the third when chasing home the classy Bossman Jack at Chepstow
runners.name: Doujadou
runners.spotlight: Well related and he won an Irish point (yielding to soft); excellent effort in chasing home last week's Turners sixth Bossman Jack at Chepstow (2m, soft), especially as this 6yo pulled clear of the third; promising and he's up in trip here.

runners.comment: He was tailed off at odds of 150-1 in a 2m maiden here a month ago
runners.name: Global Fortune
runners.spotlight: It was a modest Irish point (3m, yielding) in which he dead-heated and was tailed off at odds of 150-1 in a 2m maiden here a month ago.

runners.comment: Not the obvious answer on what he's shown but can no doubt do better; had wind op
runners.name: Grand Garcon
runners.spotlight: Second in a bumper and third, albeit a remote one, to Sober Glory on his hurdling debut (good to soft); pulled up over C&D in November but the ground was soft and he's since had wind surgery (now wears a tongue-tie); he's not the obvious answer but can no doubt do better.

runners.comment: Has to step up plenty on his 2m3f form under rules (soft/heavy)
runners.name: Mr Finch
runners.spotlight: Bought for £70,000 after his second in an Irish point; has to step up plenty on his 2m3f form under rules (soft/heavy) and likely best watched for now.

14:30.race_name: Focus Ltd Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (For The Brown Chamberlin Trophy) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Nearly won over C&D in December; heavy ground an excuse when tailed off latest
runners.name: Captain Bellamy
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in the opening novice hurdle on this card 12 months ago; looked unlucky not to win over C&D at Christmas when failing only narrowly to get up (on good); quite likely that he was unsuited by the heavy ground when a beaten favourite on his return visit and a physical issue also came to light; with this drying ground in his favour, he's right in the mix with cheekpieces added.

runners.comment: Winning hurdler this season; record of 7-8 in points bodes well for this switch to fences
runners.name: El Capitaine
runners.spotlight: Only 1-10 over hurdles, the win coming over 2m5f at Newton Abbot in October (good to soft; 7lb lower); two further good runs afterwards before finishing tailed off the last time; a record of 7-8 in points bodes well for this switch to fences.

runners.comment: Not overly appealing on his hurdling exploits but he has the look of a chaser
runners.name: Fresh Kicks
runners.spotlight: His maiden win over hurdles came at odds of 1-3 in a small field and he's since tasted defeat in three handicaps, going up 2lb for the latest second at Ludlow (2m5f, soft); difficult to call him well treated but now goes over fences and he has the look of a chaser.

runners.breeder: S Shiel D Savage & T Nolan
runners.comment: 5lb higher than for beating one exposed last time but he's an improving chaser
runners.name: He Knows Better
runners.owner: Mrs Isobel Webb & Mrs Julie Fowler
runners.spotlight: An improving chaser who did well to overcome a late mistake and get up at Southwell (2m4f, soft; fine on good to soft); he is 5lb higher for beating an exposed rival that day and this represents a harder assignment; still commands considerable respect.

runners.comment: He has at least dropped 13lb for his troubles and he'll probably come good sooner or later
runners.name: Lylian
runners.owner: T Jacobs And Mrs E Avery
runners.spotlight: French chase winner at this trip on soft ground; he hasn't really got a lot going over fences in Britain, with two 14l defeats as good as it's got; he has at least dropped 13lb for his troubles and he'll probably come good sooner or later.

runners.comment: Second in the Greatwood before his fifth at Ascot in a race that's worked out oh so well
runners.name: Helnwein
runners.spotlight: Had some very strong handicap form even before his last two runs when second to Alexei in the Greatwood and fifth in an Ascot handicap that could barely have worked out any better, with the four ahead of him all delivering high-profile efforts in the meantime; must have every chance in this lower grade; drying ground won't bother him.

runners.breeder: E A R L Trinquet & M & O Trinquet
runners.comment: Former County Hurdle winner but an 11yo now and far from solid on this season's exploits
runners.name: Faivoir
runners.spotlight: Former County Hurdle winner but an 11yo now and far from solid on this season's exploits; the handicapper isn't helping, either.

runners.breeder: Saleh Al Homaizi & Imad Al Sagar
runners.comment: Flat/hurdle winner; it was a quiet debut for the yard on the AW at Newcastle a month ago
runners.name: Gentleman Joe
runners.spotlight: Won on the Flat and over hurdles for Henry de Bromhead, but hasn't been over jumps since 2023; it was a quiet debut for new yard on the AW at Newcastle a month ago and he's not easily suggested on the back of that.

runners.comment: Collective 9lb rise demands more but should give himself every chance with a positive ride
runners.name: Cornish Storm
runners.spotlight: 2-2 since the cheekpieces went on, winning narrowly at Taunton (2m3f, good) but easier when making all at Warwick (2m, heavy); a collective 9lb rise demands more but should give himself every chance under a positive ride.

runners.comment: Ran his usual honest race when going down narrowly at Hereford in January
runners.name: Nowmelad
runners.spotlight: Just the one blip in five runs since joining Henry Oliver and ran his usual honest race when going down narrowly at Hereford in January (2m, soft; effective on drier); the winner of that race has failed to frank the form but this 7yo could still be in the thick of it here.

runners.comment: Unexposed French winner; long-time absent and best to let the market guide
runners.name: Spirou
runners.spotlight: Last run was in November 2023 when winning a French hurdle (2m2f, heavy) on his fourth career start; unexposed and in a yard that can get them straight at home, so probably best to let the market guide.

runners.comment: Running well but was beaten off this mark in a weaker race at Huntingdon last time
runners.name: Across Earth
runners.spotlight: This 5yo is having a fruitful season but he was beaten off this mark at Huntingdon last time (just before Christmas) and this is probably his stiffest test yet; respected but others are preferred for win purposes.

runners.comment: Tried chasing earlier this season and hasn't offered enough back hurdling the last twice
runners.name: Chief Sunday
runners.spotlight: Last successful 14 months ago over 2m on soft off this very mark; although that form has worked out well, he tried chasing earlier this season and hasn't offered enough back hurdling the last twice; tongue-tie applied.

15:32.race_name: Irish Thoroughbred Marketing Handicap Hurdle (Challenger Stayers Hurdle Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Moving up to 3m at this track proved an excellent fit three weeks ago when he won smoothly
runners.name: Peacenik
runners.spotlight: Progressed again on last three starts, winning two of them (good to soft); moving up to 3m at this track proved an excellent fit three weeks ago when he mostly had a clear lead before striding on again smoothly in closing stages; up another 9lb but could also prove too hot for today's rivals.

runners.breeder: S C E A Hamel Stud
runners.comment: 10yo who's not the force of old; down the weights and this race is a drop in class
runners.name: Botox Has
runners.spotlight: 10yo who's not the force of old; down the weights and this race is a drop in class, but he needs to improve on this season's form nevertheless.

runners.comment: Largely progressive before pulled up last two starts (big chase latest); well handicapped
runners.name: Lowrys Bar
runners.spotlight: Largely progressive prior to bleeding from the nose on his final start last season (February) and he did not show much when pulled up again here in November, albeit in a top 3m2f handicap chase (22-1); this is his first hurdle race since October 2024 and there are plenty of reasons to believe he's well handicapped if all is well with him.

runners.comment: Flop as favourite at Doncaster (3m, good) in December latest; needs to resume improvement
runners.name: J J Moon
runners.spotlight: Won seasonal/handicap debut at Newton Abbot (extended 2m6f, good to soft) in October; good C&D third (soft) next time but a flop as favourite at Doncaster (3m, good) in December when last seen; needs to resume improvement.

runners.comment: Below form latest start; best form this term was over C&D, so he's not entirely ruled out
runners.name: Lihyan
runners.spotlight: Ridden last nine starts by William Maggs; rarely seen on soft ground; six-time winner, most recently last May; good placed efforts at about 3m four times in a row in October-December, before he failed to show in a Pertemps qualifier at Musselburgh (10-1) nearly seven weeks ago; best form this term was over C&D, so he's not entirely ruled out.

runners.comment: Seriously unexposed on handicap debut, including with much longer trip; needs market check
runners.name: Supreme Malinas
runners.spotlight: Won a Listed bumper last term and grabbed a novice Listed event for her second hurdle win this season; put firmly in her place at Warwick (2m3f, heavy) six weeks ago but that was a Grade 2 novice and similar form; markedly better is needed for this handicap debut but she is seriously unexposed, including with the big step up in trip; market check will be interesting.

runners.comment: Tailed off on heavy latest; first foray beyond 2m6f, after 37 races and at the age of ten
runners.name: Luttrell Lad
runners.spotlight: Won at Exeter (2m2f) in November and creditable fourth at Sandown (2m4f) next time, before heavy ground might excuse his latest start; this, however, is his first foray beyond 2m6f, after 37 races and at the age of ten.

runners.comment: Well handicapped and the signs were more encouraging prior to his Bangor fall
runners.name: Galop De Chasse
runners.spotlight: He was weakening when falling in a small field at Bangor (2m4f, soft) but there were signs of returning to form and he's very well handicapped now.

runners.comment: Clear for a long way here last time before found wanting; drops back in distance
runners.name: Sheldon
runners.spotlight: Not overly consistent and can make mistakes, as was the case when the clear leader for a long way over 2m7f here a month ago (soft; fine on good to soft); that was a good run all things considered and won't mind coming back in distance.

runners.comment: Won this 12 months ago when not in the best of form so could easily stage a revival
runners.name: The Boola Boss
runners.spotlight: He wasn't in the best form coming into this race last year (good to soft), yet he battled hard for a narrow win and then followed up by 12l at Chepstow (good); only 2lb higher than for the latter win and could very easily stage a revival.

runners.comment: Made all in a good time at Taunton, won readily and may have got off lightly with 7lb
runners.name: Wheresmemoneygone
runners.spotlight: Not out of first two in four runs for this yard and he broke the track record at Taunton last month (2m5f, good to soft) when returning from a break in first-time cheekpieces; made all, won readily and may have got off lightly with 7lb.

runners.comment: First chase start in Britain when winning at Ludlow; all her form is in the mud
runners.name: Holetown
runners.spotlight: Drying ground asks a question of her but this dual chase winner in France was seeing British fences for the first time when leading late on at Ludlow (2m4f, soft); that was a useful little race and a 6lb rise might not be too damaging.

runners.comment: Irish raider 3-8 over fences; does seem to have a penchant for deep ground
runners.name: One Horse Army
runners.spotlight: Irish raider who had been hurdling before a successful return to fences over 3m at Fairyhouse last time (heavy), having dug deep to make it 3-8 in this discipline; does seem to have a penchant for deep ground so that's the concern.

runners.comment: Bumped into a well-treated favourite off this 5lb higher mark at Chepstow
runners.name: Another Fine Mess
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles before a successful chase debut at Doncaster (2m4f, soft; by 3l); bumped into a well-treated favourite off this 5lb higher mark at Chepstow when the hood was left off (as today); should have some part to play.

runners.comment: Unexposed as a chaser (2-4) but only beat two other finishers last time at Fakenham
runners.name: Kalista Love
runners.owner: Hot To Trot Jumping And Dahlbury
runners.spotlight: 2-4 over fences, her latest success when seeing off two other finishers at Fakenham (2m5f, soft) a month ago; up 5lb but still unexposed as a chaser.

runners.comment: Beaten 7l after wind surgery at Ludlow (3m, soft) when let down by his jumping
runners.name: Petty Cash
runners.spotlight: Won over a bit further at Chepstow two seasons ago (good to soft) and then off for a year; two good runs since returning, last time beaten 7l after wind surgery at Ludlow (3m, soft) when let down by his jumping; could go well if that part of his game holds up.

runners.comment: Second chase start when a keeping-on fourth here; he surely has more to offer
runners.name: King Califet
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced 7yo who had wind surgery after a disappointing chase debut and then showed plenty more when a keeping-on fourth in a competitive Class 3 handicap here three weeks ago (good to soft); surely has more to offer.

runners.comment: Has new headgear on but all his three career wins have come at about 2m
runners.name: Dunstall Rambler
runners.spotlight: Weakened to be beaten 22l last time at Southwell (2m4f, good to soft) and all his three wins have been at about 2m; wouldn't be the obvious answer no matter how well the new headgear works.

16:42.race_name: Daily Bet Boost With BetVictor Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Bit to prove back at 3m but was an easy winner here last time over shorter; up 7lb
runners.name: De Kingpin
runners.spotlight: Failed to take to fences; third in a big field over C&D (good to soft) before running away with another handicap at 2m4f here (soft); could cope with the 7lb rise if proving as effective back up in trip.

runners.comment: Suffered another dip in form at Ffos Las and he does handle heavy ground; others safer
runners.name: Gold In The Rivers
runners.spotlight: Ground it out returned to hurdling at Market Rasen (2m7f, soft) but suffered another dip in form at Ffos Las and he does handle heavy ground; others safer.

runners.comment: There's a competitive show in him should the new cheekpieces trigger something
runners.name: High Treason
runners.spotlight: Started the season over fences and that didn't go well; his fifth over C&D in January was encouraging but again failed to fire at Ascot; there's a competitive show in him should the new cheekpieces (on for a visor) trigger something.

runners.comment: Best form has been in the mud but needs considering after chasing home an improver
runners.name: Livingit Du Large
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced junior hurdle winner; back from wind surgery when second in a three-finisher field at Fontwell (2m5f, heavy) and the winner is seriously progressive; best form has been in the mud but needs considering.

runners.breeder: E A R L De La Cauvelliere
runners.comment: Beaten about 15l in two runs over hurdles; headgear turned to for this handicap debut
runners.name: Jackpot Cauveliere
