runners.spotlight: Bought for £100,000 after winning an Irish point by 20l; no closer than 15l in two runs over hurdles (2m4f/2m5f) but Harry Derham turns to cheekpieces for this handicap debut over a longer trip and any confidence in the betting should be heeded.

runners.comment: Third on handicap debut at Ludlow and stepping up from 2m5f could make a difference
runners.name: Name Me Nicely
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who ran an encouraging race on handicap debut at Ludlow (third of eight; beaten 10l; 11-2) and stepping up from 2m5f could make a difference; considered.

runners.comment: Could have run better the last twice but he's perhaps back over a more suitable trip
runners.name: Duffry Trixs
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner; only six ran when a 10l third in his first handicap (2m7f, good to soft) but should really have run better since then, for all that he was back over 2m4f.

runners.comment: Best run came in a race that didn't have a lot of depth; handicap debut
runners.name: Times Are Green
runners.spotlight: Best run was an 11l second of eight in a 2m7f novice at Chepstow (2m7f, good to soft) two starts back; that race didn't have a lot of depth, however; handicap debut.

runners.comment: In-form mare but going up 2lb for a 2l defeat is never ideal; should still run well
runners.name: Either Or
runners.spotlight: Last two runs in a tongue-tie; value for her narrow winning margin at Doncaster (3m, good to soft) and probably ran just as well in defeat at Plumpton (soft); did go up 2lb for that 2l defeat which was annoying.

runners.comment: Signs of running back into fourth when a near 10l third of 15 at Wincanton
runners.name: Mini Mildred
runners.spotlight: Followed up four Flat wins with a maiden hurdle win in Jersey in June 2024; had a long absence afterwards but signs of running back into form when a near 10l third of 15 at Wincanton (2m4f, good to soft); wouldn't be certain to stay this far, however.

runners.comment: Second in a Haydock handicap before getting stuck in the mud in a maiden at Hereford
runners.name: Douglas Hyde
runners.spotlight: Won his point on heavy but similar ground was very taxing when beaten 28l by the favourite in a 3m1f Hereford maiden last time; went close in a Haydock handicap the time before off 4lb lower (3m, good); enters the reckoning.

runners.comment: Off 11 months; new trainer has secured Harry Cobden; has threatened off this mark
runners.name: Rialannah
runners.spotlight: A 15-race maiden who has pulled up in three of her last five races and she's returning from 11 months off; however, booking of Harry Cobden bodes well on debut for new yard and she has threatened off this mark (and at 3m).

runners.breeder: G Durrheim And Maria Mulcahy Durrheim
runners.comment: Hasn't had a lot of racing and deserved his 7lb rise after winning easily at Doncaster
runners.name: Swift Jet
runners.spotlight: Bounced back from two falls over fences to win pretty much as he liked over hurdles at Doncaster (3m, good to soft); this looks a better race and he's 7lb higher, but this gelding hasn't had a lot of racing.

runners.comment: Ex-Irish 8yo who isn't having the best of seasons and beat one home at Ludlow recently
runners.name: Ring O Roses
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 8yo who isn't having the best of seasons and beat one home at Ludlow recently (3m).

runners.breeder: Ecurie Biraben D Biraben & A Biraben
runners.comment: Well-held third of five on her return to hurdling over C&D a month ago
runners.name: Kosasiempre
runners.spotlight: Won over 3m1f as a chaser earlier in the season but was a well-held third of five on her return to hurdling over C&D a month ago (soft no excuse); others preferred with cheekpieces now given a go.

runners.comment: Likely best watched after a change of yard, especially with stamina to prove
runners.name: Staff Sergeant Len
runners.spotlight: Held every chance when unseating late on in a chase at Wincanton on Boxing Day (2m4f); again let down by his jumping at Ludlow; sold for £19,500 since; likely best watched after a change of yard, especially back over hurdles with stamina to prove.

17:16.race_name: Highclere Horse Feeds Oataalin Open Hunters' Chase

runners.comment: Quite closely matched with Java Point on their Ludlow form in January
runners.name: Fil dAriane
runners.spotlight: Quite closely matched with Java Point on their Ludlow form in January (3m, good to soft) and this 11yo has held his form in points; he still looks vulnerable from a win perspective.

runners.comment: Soft ground against him when no match for Jeffery's Cross last time and better expected
runners.name: Java Point
runners.spotlight: Has always been useful; ran in a handicap on debut for this yard and then beat Fil d'Ariane at Ludlow (3m, good to soft); perhaps found soft ground against him when no match for Jeffery's Cross last time and better can be expected.

runners.comment: With the cheekpieces back on her made light work of Java Point at Southwell
runners.name: Jefferys Cross
runners.spotlight: Has a solid record in hunter chases and he chased home last week's Cheltenham hero Barton Snow (did win by 12l) before making light work of Java Point at Southwell (3m, soft; cheekpieces returned); in the mix.

runners.comment: Second two years ago but doesn't appear to be in the same form this time around
runners.name: Regatta De Blanc
runners.spotlight: Bang in form when runner-up in this two years ago and later that year finished second in a 3m handicap chase at Ascot for Paul Nicholls; however, signed off for him on a downer and December's point run was none too promising; revival needed in the new cheekpieces.

runners.comment: He's 12 now and was pulled up in a recent point after quite a lengthy break
runners.name: Arthurs Sixpence
runners.spotlight: A three-time winner over regulation fences and prolific in points (5-7); however, he's 12 now and was pulled up in a recent point after quite a lengthy break; has a bit on his plate at any rate.

runners.breeder: S C E A De Maulde
runners.comment: Pulled up in a recent point but he did very nearly win this race 12 months ago
runners.name: Empire De Maulde
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in the same point last month in which Arthur's Sixpence suffered the same fate; that muddies the waters but did well in points and hunter chases last year, including a near-miss in this race.

runners.comment: Hunter chase debut and did run well in a strong Cheltenham handicap three runs back
runners.name: Inch House
runners.spotlight: Has essentially become disappointing since his novice season but he did run well first time back in a strong Cheltenham handicap (3m1f, good) and this is his hunter chase debut; disappointing if he's not involved.

runners.breeder: S C E A Le Haras DHaspel
runners.comment: Famously gone 0-19 over fences but perhaps this will be the day in his first hunter chase
runners.name: Mister Coffey
runners.spotlight: A classy chaser who has famously gone 0-19 in this discipline, running numerous good races in smart company and finishing runner-up nine times; did run well for a long way in a veterans' chase at Cheltenham last month (3m2f, good to soft) and this might just be the day it happens for him.

14:12.race_name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Apprentice Handicap

runners.comment: Two staying handicap wins last summer, including C&D; not fully exposed; shortlisted
runners.name: Senor Cortez
runners.spotlight: Improved when sent over staying trips and handicapping last summer, getting off the mark at Yarmouth in August before running away with a C&D handicap three weeks later; came up shy off his revised mark in two starts for Darryll Holland but he still has time to do better; promising apprentice booked for this first start for John Butler.

runners.comment: Arrives in good form but steps up markedly in trip and, being by Blue Point, it's a query
runners.name: Jodhpur Blue
runners.spotlight: Still to add to his 7f maiden win for Charles Hills in October 2024 but he has been banging at the door this year, placed on his last four starts (1m2f-1m4f); goes into unknown territory in terms of stamina and he's by Blue Point so there has to be a question mark.

runners.breeder: S C E A Haras De Gratte Panche Et Al
runners.comment: Ready 1m6f win on yard debut at Southwell ten days ago; good 7lb claimer booked; chance
runners.name: St Faz
runners.spotlight: Strong at the finish when making a winning stable debut at Southwell ten days ago (1m6f; well backed); 2lb wrong under his penalty but a good 7lb claimer has been booked; should be fine at the trip and he's a strong contender.

runners.breeder: Lynn Lodge Stud & Pier House Stud
runners.comment: C&D winner and running okay of late; losing run stretches back to July 2023 though
runners.name: Bashful Boy
runners.spotlight: Losing run dates back to July 2023; conditions are no problem for this veteran and he has been running respectably of late; others appeal more all the same.

runners.comment: Chelmsford win in January followed by a lacklustre run 4 weeks ago; up in trip; new visor
runners.name: Relocal
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the eighth attempt when landing a Chelmsford handicap over an extended 1m5f in January; lacklustre effort over 1m5f here four weeks ago and connections now step him up in trip in a change of headgear.

runners.comment: 1m6f win at Southwell in January; held his form since; shouldn't be too far away
runners.name: Prince Quattro
runners.owner: Ursa Major Ltd & Hicky Parmar Racing
runners.spotlight: Recorded his first Flat success when scoring at Southwell in January (1m6f); he has run to a similar level in defeat since and he should remain competitive.

runners.comment: Hurdle winner in December; more to prove on the Flat, not least his stamina
runners.name: Dissident
runners.owner: Ben Haynes And Mrs Samantha Dunn
runners.spotlight: Fine pedigree but he has failed to progress on the Flat, well beaten in two Kempton handicaps for this yard in October; has won over hurdles this winter but well short of his best in that discipline on his last two runs; arrives with something to prove, not least his stamina.

14:42.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Solid 2yo form prior to disappointing handicap debut in November; upped in trip for return
runners.name: Exotic Baby
runners.spotlight: Four runs as a 2yo, winning a 1m maiden at Southwell on his second start and showing better form when third under a penalty at Kempton last October; absent since a disappointing nursery debut at Wolverhampton 132 days ago; steps up in distance for his reappearance; not yet exposed.

runners.comment: 1m Brighton maiden win in October; in at the deep end in Group 1 latest; can do better
runners.name: A Taste Of Glory
runners.spotlight: Improved with each of his first three runs as a 2yo, winning a 1m maiden at Brighton in October; faced a stiff task upped to Group 1 company in France 19 days later (1m2f, very soft) and came up well short; the fact he was even considered for that race suggests an opening mark of 80 should be within range.

runners.comment: Runner-up in two AW maidens this year; looked a hard ride latest and now gets headgear
runners.name: Al Azd
runners.spotlight: Improved for a gelding operation/switch to AW this winter, finishing second to an exciting prospect at Kempton in January (1m) before filling the same position over C&D five weeks ago; looked a tricky ride last time, however, and no surprise to see headgear reached for.

runners.comment: Runner-up twice before comfortable front-running win in January (1m); new trip should suit
runners.name: Alba Gu Brath
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on his first two starts before making all to win at Newcastle ten weeks ago (all 1m); he will need further progress to defy this mark but the longer trip looks a positive on breeding.

runners.comment: Improved for step up in trip/switch to handicaps with AW win (9.4f) in November; unexposed
runners.name: Impossible Mission
runners.spotlight: Promise in novice/maiden company at 1m; improved for the step up in trip/switch to handicaps when seeing off five rivals at Wolverhampton (9.4f) in November, still looking to be a work in progress; 5lb rise asks a stiffer question of him on his return to action.

runners.comment: Strong finish to win at Chelmsford (1m) three weeks ago; form boosted; much more to come
runners.name: Felix Gem
runners.spotlight: Powered home to win a 1m novice at Chelmsford three weeks ago and that form has been advertised with the second and third winning next time; stepping back up in trip should suit and he is a leading contender now switched to handicaps.

runners.comment: Finished best when 2nd at Kempton on February's stable debut; stamina query but mark fair
runners.name: Sudbury Hill
runners.spotlight: Comfortably the fastest finisher in a well-run 1m handicap at Kempton on last month's stable debut, beaten just a neck; stamina for the extra 2f has to be taken on trust but his stable are going well over jumps and he could still have mileage in this mark.

15:12.race_name: Win £250,000 With BetMGM's Golden Goals Handicap

runners.comment: C&D winner; not at best this winter but the drop into a 0-70 could prompt a bigger effort
runners.name: This Farh
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; yet to match last summer's turf form this winter; latest run was slightly better and now drops into 0-70 company; a better run could be forthcoming.

runners.comment: C&D win on stable debut in December; no further progress in three runs in January
runners.name: Me Tarzan
runners.spotlight: C&D winner on his stable debut in January; unable to build on that effort in three runs in January; others are preferred for win purposes.

runners.comment: Yet to win a handicap despite an easing mark; talented but frustrating; stamina to prove
runners.name: Cayman Tai
runners.spotlight: Unable to capitalise on his much-reduced mark this winter; good run over 5f here last month but disappointed when a warm favourite at Wolverhampton three weeks ago; stamina for 7f wouldn't be assured.

runners.comment: Latest 5f run easy to forgive and he holds each-way claims judged on earlier course form
runners.name: Way To Dubai
runners.spotlight: In good form over 1m here this year and latest effort, when dropped to 5f, is easy to excuse; this should be more suitable and he is not handicapped out of things.

runners.comment: 3-3 over C&D and he was better than ever last time; up 5lb but he's a major player again
runners.name: Profit Street
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten in three starts over C&D, keeping on well to justify odds-on favouritism a fortnight ago; another 5lb higher today but foolish to think it will prove beyond him.

runners.comment: 7f win at Southwell last month but less good in Class 5 latest; others appeal more
runners.name: My Mate Mike
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f handicap at Southwell on his second run back with Dean Ivory; unable to back it up in a Class 5 a fortnight later; fully effective over C&D but others appear to hold stronger claims.

runners.comment: Running well this year, including a win on her last attempt at 7f; one to consider
runners.name: Twirler
runners.spotlight: In a good run of form this year, winning over 7f at Kempton last month and placed over 6f on her three other starts; drawn widest but still likely to give a good account back up in distance.

runners.comment: Enjoyed productive winter, winning four times, but the handicapper may have caught up now
runners.name: Royal Jet
runners.spotlight: Four wins, including C&D, this winter and latest Chelmsford run probably not the one to judge him on; that said, he wouldn't look to have much wiggle room off his current mark.

runners.comment: Four wins last year, all in Class 6 company; returns from a break in a higher grade
runners.name: Ajrad
runners.spotlight: Won four Class 6 handicaps (7f-1m) in 2025; just 1lb higher than for the latest of them but up in grade for his first run since October.

runners.comment: No impact in two 5f runs for new stable; steps back up in trip off a reduced mark
runners.name: Tomarlo
runners.spotlight: Of interest on his Irish form but two runs (5f) for his new stable leave him with a point to prove; placed over 7f as a 2yo.

15:45.race_name: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D) (GBB)

runners.comment: Modest form in three runs last autumn (7f-1m); hooded for return; may do better yet
runners.name: Athenas War
runners.spotlight: Ran to a modest level in her three runs (7f-1m, turf and Polytrack) last autumn; hooded for her reappearance; improvement required to win but it's not out of the question.

runners.comment: Recent Wolverhampton debut 4th (7f) not without hope; improvement a must though
runners.name: Dusk Damsel
runners.owner: Ms H N Pinniger And Partner
runners.spotlight: Recent Wolverhampton debut (7f; beaten 8.25l into fourth) wasn't without hope but she will need a jolt of improvement to trouble the principals.

runners.comment: Reappearance 5th was much better than her debut run; should do better in handicaps
runners.name: Gifts Differing
runners.spotlight: Last month's Chelmsford fifth (1m) was a good step forward from her 2yo debut effort; another leap forward is necessary to take this.

runners.comment: Uninspiring debut at Chelmsford last week; bred to do much better at some stage
runners.name: Action Reaction
runners.spotlight: Useful pedigree but she made an uninspiring debut at Chelmsford last week (1m; 11-1), always behind after a slow start; needs to have learned a lot in a short space of time.

runners.comment: Good middle-distance pedigree; starts out in a winnable event; needs a close market check
runners.name: Desert Belle
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; closely related to 1m-1m2f winner Dubai Icon (including 2yo/AW; RPR 111), half-sister to winners Haya (1m1f; 83) and Queen Of Cordoba (Argentinian 1m/1m1f); dam 1m2f/1m4f winner (86), half-sister to 7f-1m2f Group 1 winner Rio De La Plata; starts out in a winnable event and market confidence would look significant.

runners.comment: Modest form in two turf runs over shorter last summer; should do better at some point
runners.name: Politely
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two turf runs over shorter last summer; should do better at some point.

runners.comment: Half-sister to two winners out of a 1m4f AW winner; the betting should guide on debut
runners.name: Sharp Romance
runners.spotlight: 2,500gns foal; half-sister to winners Charming Whisper (7f-1m2f including 2yo; RPR 87) and Mister Phoenix (German 8.7f); dam 1m4f AW winner (74); enough paper appeal to warrant a market check in a weak maiden.

runners.comment: Fair form at up to 7f last year; 1m should be within range on breeding; key player
runners.name: Sovereign Bright
runners.spotlight: Failed to build on a promising run at Doncaster on her second start (7f good to firm); that effort sets the standard though and 1m should be well within range on pedigree (half-sister to a Chester Cup winner out of a mare who won over 1m4f); absent since October but still high on the list.

runners.comment: Half-sister to two winners out of a prolific 7f-1m4f winner; market check advised
runners.name: Tiny Tiger
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to winners Tipsy Tiger (1m 2yo/1m2f; RPR 85) and Little Tiger (1m2f; 66); dam prolific 7f-1m4f winner (including AW; 69); starts out in an uncompetitive maiden so a market check is required.

16:17.race_name: Bet £10 Get £40 With BetMGM Fillies' Handicap

runners.comment: Consistent rather than progressive; needs to raise her game to defy top weight
runners.name: Welljudged
runners.spotlight: Consistent rather than progressive and she finished a well-beaten fifth of six in her one handicap start; could still have a bigger effort in her but she will need it to defy top weight.

runners.comment: Effective over C&D and progressed for this yard last summer; respected back from a break
runners.name: Rogue Dynasty
runners.spotlight: She made a winning debut for James Owen at Chester (7f, good) last July and finished second in three of her four subsequent runs (including C&D); absent for six months but she still has relatively low mileage and could kick on again this year.

runners.comment: Dropping down the weights but with some justification; far too much to prove for comfort
runners.name: Cartwheel
runners.spotlight: 7f novice winner as a 2yo; little to recommend her judged on her four handicap runs, the latest over 7f here three weeks ago (50-1; hooded first time); drops in class today and with a reduced mark; far too much to prove for comfort.

runners.comment: 3-6 since joining this yard; wide trip when disappointing last time; could resume progress
runners.name: Salaria
runners.spotlight: The winner of three of her six starts (8.6f-1m2f) since joining Charlie Clover; failed to fire at Wolverhampton when last seen in December but she endured a wide trip and can be given a pass; could yet rate higher.

runners.comment: Made all for wins at Sandown and Epsom last summer; down the field twice last month
runners.name: Tronido
runners.spotlight: Course winner; two front-running soft-ground turf wins last year and of interest on that form; her two runs last month will need bettering though.

runners.comment: Five course wins this winter but below par last time; needs to rebound with a career best
runners.name: Dandy Khan
runners.spotlight: Five course wins this winter, including over this trip; disappointing effort here two weeks ago and she needs to rebound with a career best.

runners.comment: C&D win last month and scored again at Kempton 18 days ago; up in grade today
runners.name: Rosemarys Rose
runners.spotlight: C&D classified win last month marked her down as one who could hold her own in better company; added to her tally with a Kempton success 18 days ago (1m; 0-55); up 5lb and steps into Class 5 but she shouldn't be underestimated.

16:50.race_name: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap

runners.comment: Two 5f wins in January; not at his best last week and drawn wider than ideal today
runners.name: Master Dandy
runners.spotlight: 5f wins at Wolverhampton and Chelmsford (beat Forever Noah by a head) in January; took a backwards step at Newcastle nine days ago and he has an awkward draw to contend with this time.

runners.comment: On a fair mark on his 2025 best but he has a 172-day absence to defy
runners.name: Reporter
runners.spotlight: On a fair mark on last season's best, including a 5f win at Windsor in June; absent 172 days and he'll need to be cherry ripe to take this.

runners.comment: Good 2nd on stable debut last September; less good twice this year; new headgear today
runners.name: Running Cool
runners.spotlight: Fine second at Wolverhampton on his stable debut last September; not so good in two runs this year and hopes rest on the new cheekpieces turning things around.

runners.comment: Poor strike-rate but he'd been running well before a lesser run 18 days ago; new headgear
runners.name: Forever Noah
runners.spotlight: Just one win to his name after 19 starts but he had been in good form prior to a lesser effort at Wolverhampton 18 days ago; cheekpieces now reached for.

runners.comment: C&D winner; on a dangerous mark and she's a key player from the inside stall
runners.name: Wedgewood
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer who has dropped to a mark 3lb lower than when last successful (April 2025); well drawn and she should have a big run in her.

runners.comment: 11-race maiden; penultimate effort was promising but less good back at 5f last time
runners.name: Sonic Si
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden; not beaten far over 6f on his penultimate start but he failed to build on it back at 5f 18 days ago; stable also run Wedgewood.

runners.comment: Tumbling down the weights; drop to 5f could help and his rider claims a useful 5lb
runners.name: Stapleford Park
runners.spotlight: Dropped 15lb in five runs for new trainer since September; looks quick enough to cope with the shorter trip and Ryan Kavanagh takes off a valuable 5lb; better can be expected today.

runners.comment: Not hit top gear yet this year but he is edging down the weights
runners.name: Coolagh Magic
runners.owner: Lady Emma Oshea And A Carson
runners.spotlight: Not found his best form this winter but his latest run was more encouraging and he has slipped to a handy mark; needs to up his game but it is not out of the question.

runners.comment: Down to an extremely tempting mark but this sharp 5f isn't sure to suit
runners.name: Comedian Leader
runners.spotlight: She has slipped to a dangerous mark and her latest Class 5 run here was more encouraging; that was over 1m though and the suitability of this sharp 5f looks open to debate.

runners.comment: Not operating at her best of late; opposable from the widest stall
runners.name: Isla Bella
runners.spotlight: Returning to 5f should help but she hasn't been at her best of late and she has the widest stall to contend with this time.

17:25.race_name: Daily Profit Boosts At betmgm.co.uk Handicap

runners.comment: Five wins (6f-7f) and climbed 38lb up weights since December; another personal best needed
runners.name: Goldmoyne
runners.spotlight: Having a fine winter, winning twice over 6f in December and finding another surge of progress in recent weeks, completing a 7f hat-trick with a narrow success at Southwell last week; now 38lb higher than for the first win and he will need yet another career best to score; stayed 1m in Ireland but usually runs over shorter.

runners.comment: Back to form with a close front-running second last week; leading contender
runners.name: Bravo Zulu
runners.spotlight: Having slipped down the weights he ran his best race this winter when a front-running second at Wolverhampton last week (8.6f); ready to strike and he doesn't have to lead.

runners.comment: Multiple AW winner, including C&D, but more comfortable in Class 5; absent 109 days
runners.name: Arctician
runners.spotlight: Multiple AW winner, including C&D, but yet to win off a mark this high; creditable effort at Kempton (7f; Class 4) when last seen in December; could prove vulnerable at this level once again.

runners.comment: Big prices and well beaten in two runs for new stable this year; best watched for now
runners.name: Good Speed
runners.spotlight: A winner in France in September 2024; big prices and well beaten in two runs for his new yard this year; may need some more assistance from the handicapper.

runners.breeder: S A R L Ecurie Jean Louis Bouchard
runners.comment: In good form in blinkers last summer but no history of going well fresh; cheekpieces today
runners.name: Warning Sign
runners.spotlight: In good form in blinkers last summer, winning twice at Sandown (1m and 1m2f) before placed efforts at Epsom and Newmarket; has tended to need his reappearance in the past so perhaps one to watch with an eye to the future; cheekpieces on today.

runners.comment: Two course wins (7f) and still feasibly weighted; this may be run to suit her
runners.name: Lady Manzor
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f fillies' handicap here last Good Friday; unplaced in her two runs this winter but she hasn't been discredited; should get a good pace to aim at this time.

runners.comment: Conditions no problem and he made an encouraging return from a lengthy absence last month
runners.name: Red Hat Eagle
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; made good progress in 2024 and he made a satisfactory return from a lengthy absence at Southwell three weeks ago; dropped 2lb and could take a step forward this time.

runners.breeder: Ballybin Stud Ltd & Patrick F Kelly
runners.comment: 7f win here in January but twice a beaten favourite since; new trip needs to revive him
runners.name: Maximising
runners.spotlight: Ran out the ready winner of a 7f handicap here in January; beaten favourite in two 7f handicaps since and steps up to 1m on a retrieval mission.

runners.comment: Three wins from his last five starts; good third over C&D last time; in the mix again
runners.name: Foreseen
runners.spotlight: The winner of three of his last five starts and ran another solid race when third of ten off this mark over C&D five weeks ago; should remain competitive.

runners.comment: Stays 1m but all wins at 7f, the latest 18 days ago; each-way claims once more
runners.name: Tadreeb
runners.spotlight: Stays 1m but all eight of his wins have come over 7f, the latest at Kempton 18 days ago; should get a good pace to aim at and he holds each-way claims again.
